prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.ts with named exports.
Required API: export function decodeHex(text: string): number[] | null
Behavior: Decode pairs of ASCII hexadecimal digits, accepting upper or lower case. Reject odd length, non-ASCII, or any non-hex digit; empty input succeeds with an empty byte sequence.
Visible example: "4A00ff" produces bytes [74, 0, 255].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Required API: export function decodeHex(text: string): number[] | null
Behavior: Decode pairs of ASCII hexadecimal digits, accepting upper or lower case. Reject odd length, non-ASCII, or any non-hex digit; empty input succeeds with an empty byte sequence.
Visible example: "4A00ff" produces bytes [74, 0, 255].

reference.code: export function decodeHex(s:string):number[]|null{if(s.length%2)return null;const o:number[]=[];for(let i=0;i<s.length;i+=2){const p=s.slice(i,i+2);if(!/^[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$/.test(p))return null;o.push(parseInt(p,16))}return o}
